source: foundation/BACKLOG-UX.md — QR preset edit/regenerate/validate/reset, selected preset control panel, local reference and export/import
objective: Create a DOM-free QR Studio session model for the six system presets: selection, editable drafts, dirty/editing state, regeneration through an injected generator, validation as the local session reference, reset to reference/canonical and optional codec/storage delegation, without duplicating PresetManager catalogue operations.

coordination.qr_schema: QRStudioSchema #88 is integrated and consumed read-only.
coordination.qr_wiz: QRWiz remains the generator source of truth and is not modified; generation is injected.
coordination.qr_codec_storage: QRPresetCodec/QRPresetStorage remain the serialization/storage sources of truth and are consumed via adapters only.
coordination.preset_manager: Generic create/duplicate/rename/delete operations stay in PresetManager and are not duplicated.
coordination.agent_b: AssetLogoProfile remains on core/asset-logo-profile.js + test/doc and is disjoint.
coordination.agent_d: DataJoin KeyMatcher #89 is integrated; no QR session scope observed.

notes: No QRWiz, codec, storage, PresetManager, schema, demo, CSS or roadmap canonical files modified.
